description.value:
No one understands you more than your eidolon and vice versa. Using this innate understanding, you transform your eidolon into your identical twin, allowing them to hide their presence or impersonate you to a limited extent. Assuming you are a humanoid, the eidolon gains the humanoid trait in addition to its other traits while it's in this form, as well as any other trait related to your form (such as elf or gnome). Your eidolon gains a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to Impersonate you and can add its level to such checks even if it's untrained.

Although your eidolon looks like you, it doesn't gain any new abilities, and its statistics don't change in any way-the transformation is purely cosmetic. If this transformation reduces your eidolon's size, the eidolon loses any other effects of its larger size, such as any increase to reach. Your eidolon can still use gear only if it has the eidolon trait, which allows eidolons to use it. If necessary, any such eidolon items the eidolon was wearing remain active but change size and shape to reflect what you're wearing.

You can Dismiss the spell to return your eidolon to their original form.

Heightened (4th) The duration increases to 1 hour.
